name: White-Water River Rafting (Grade III & IV)
desc: Conquer exhilarating rapids like Roller Coaster, Golf Course, and Club House along the wild turquoise Ganges.

name: Giant Bungee Jump (83 meters)
desc: India's highest fixed-platform cantilever bungee jump suspended over the Hall river valley.

name: Himalayan Skiing & Snowboarding Courses
desc: Glide down powdery slopes with certified instructors facing the awe-inspiring Nanda Devi massif.

name: Royal Bengal Tiger Jeep Safari
desc: Deep jungle exploration in open 4x4 gypsies tracking tigers, Asiatic elephants, gharials, and over 600 bird species.

name: Tungnath & Chandrashila Peak Trek
desc: Ascend through alpine rhododendron woods to the 1000-year-old Shiva shrine and summit at 4000m altitude.

name: Ganga Evening Maha Aarti
location: Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar & Triveni Ghat, Rishikesh
desc: Experience the transcendent evening ritual with towering brass multi-tiered lamps, Vedic chants, and floating floral diyas.
